summary.executiveSummaryReference: The client call clarified DITA’s product and information flow from Japanese suppliers through Netherlands fiscal clearance to Park West storage and European dispatch. The team discussed how QMS procedures should match real business processes, and reviewed UDI, lot numbering, label design, EUDAMED responsibilities, MedEnvoy oversight, DoCs, language considerations and HPRA fees. The internal follow-up added scope clarity around sunglasses/PPE, working-session planning, site-visit planning and the need for client clarification questions.
